subject.title: feat(comfy): dynamic aspect ratio → width/height injection

question: Should Comfy expose size and aspect-ratio capability only for workflows with a validated dimensions mapping, and if so which image-generation contract should carry that configuration-aware capability before selection?
rationale: The existing provider capability shape is static, while Comfy workflow support varies by operator configuration; choosing between a core capability-contract extension and retaining a deliberately limited plugin contract is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Add configuration-aware capability resolution
options.body: Extend or use an approved image-generation capability path so Comfy advertises geometry only when the selected workflow has valid dimensions mappings, then preserve that invariant in tests.

options.title: Keep static capabilities with explicit degraded semantics
options.body: Accept that unmapped workflows may be selected for geometry requests and define a documented, caller-visible fallback contract that consumers can safely handle.

options.title: Defer geometry support
options.body: Keep Comfy geometry capabilities disabled until the owner-approved configuration-aware contract is available.

recommendation.title: Add configuration-aware capability resolution
recommendation.body: Extend or use an approved image-generation capability path so Comfy advertises geometry only when the selected workflow has valid dimensions mappings, then preserve that invariant in tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is an image-generation product and provider-capability contract rather than a local Comfy parsing detail.
